claim: Through the 20x objective the trapping laser (1064 nm) delivered 64, 126 and 380 mW at 5, 10 and 30% level, inside the power meter head's range, and 633 mW at 50%, above it -- roughly in proportion to the level.

numbers.name: illumination_power
numbers.note: at 50% level; above the S121C's 500 mW range

validity_conditions: Worksheet Power rows 128-132; 0 % read 0. Each number is at the level its note names, in order. The three below 500 mW are inside the S121C's range and carry their significant figures; 633 mW is above it. Roughly 12-13 mW per percent across the range, which is proportional to within the scatter of four points; not entered as a linearity claim. Measured 2026-09-09 by Kyu Hwan Choi and Saksham Malik with a Thorlabs PM100A and an S121C photodiode head (the person, 2026-09-24), wavelength set to the line, every spot inside the sensor. Mirror in, multiband in, IR in. Valid to 2036-09-24. WHAT THE LEVEL IS: the trapping laser's level setting as used in the measurement; trap_laser_power_has_no_software_path records that software can neither set nor read it.
